interactables.name: Wexler
interactables.text: The Director, [Wexler], has three cameras of footage to review and is instead watching the room like it owes him a third act. He frames you between his fingers. 'Cat. Great texture. Stay in the light.'

topics.text: He does not get angry. He gets ideas. 'Missing bird. Weeping star. Locked mansion. A cat crosses the frame.' He writes fast. '[Emmy bait], all of it. You cannot BUY a crisis like this.' He underlines something twice.

He slides it out from under you with the ease of a man who has worked with talent before. 'The crew? Grips are asleep. Camera department is unionized. And [Marsh] - Marsh is my rock. Used to file a complaint about that bird every single day. Hasn't said a word in two weeks. Personal growth, probably.'

topics.prompt: Stare pointedly at the red pen in his pocket
topics.text: He follows your gaze down to the pen, then back up. 'The shot list. [BETTER WITHOUT HIM], question mark. Note the question mark, cat - that is editorial instinct, not a confession.' He clicks the pen twice. 'Though if it WERE a confession, the ratings would be extraordinary.'

interactables.name: The Sound Guy
interactables.text: The [Sound Guy]'s badge reads '[D. Marsh].' He is very busy re-coiling a cable that was already coiled. 'Nice cat,' he says, half an octave too high. The coil slips out of his hands.

topics.prompt: Stare at him. Do not blink.
topics.text: He lasts eleven seconds. 'What. WHAT. It's boom mics, okay? I do boom mics.' He wipes his palms on his sleeves. 'Look, I was HERE at seven. Library. Audio setup. It's [on the schedule]. Check the schedule. Everyone should check the schedule.'

He grabs them protectively. 'I'm monitoring levels.' You look at the jack. He looks at the jack. The cable ends a foot short of the board, plugged into [nothing at all]. 'Wireless monitoring,' he explains, to a cat, with total conviction.

topics.prompt: Follow the wall cable with your eyes, slowly
topics.text: You trace it: board, floor, wainscoting, gone. He watches you do it. 'That's [grounding]. Cables need grounding. Into walls. It's an audio thing, you wouldn't-' He stops himself explaining audio engineering to a cat, sits down at the mixer, and very carefully touches nothing.

topics.prompt: Sit at his feet, smelling of tarp and potting shed
topics.text: You settle in close - close enough that he can smell exactly where you have been: mulch, tarp, cold metal latches. He goes pale. 'They're empty! The cases are [EMPTY], both of them, why would I even-' He hears himself say it. The library gets very, very quiet. 'I have a lot of levels to monitor,' he whispers.

topics.prompt: Sit on the mixing board and stare into his soul
topics.text: He tries to wait you out. Nobody has ever waited out a cat.|'FINE. You want the truth? That bird ruined [forty-seven takes]. FORTY-SEVEN. Do you know what that does to a person who listens for a living? I hear the squawk when I close my eyes.'|He catches his breath, and something careful comes back into his voice. 'But nobody HURT anybody. Wherever that bird is, I am sure he is... comfortable. Safer than that circus of a living room, probably.' His eyes drift to the window, out toward the garden. He looks away slowly, like the view is an ex.

interactables.text: The mixing board hums, still powered on long after wrap. An [Audio Cable] leaves the back panel and vanishes [into the wall].
A session log wedged behind the podium: 'TAKE 12 - bird. TAKE 23 - bird. TAKE 47 - [RUINED. BIRD. AGAIN.]' The handwriting gets angrier with every page. The last page has torn through.
The Director's shot list for today. Items include: 'Rudebeak reaction shot - [CANCELLED].' Next to it, in red pen: '[BETTER WITHOUT HIM?]'

localDeductionSentence: Wexler smells an Emmy - meanwhile [Sound Guy] left his mixer humming, an [Audio Cable] runs into the wall, and the session log is one long scream about [Ruined Takes].
